method: closed-mesh volume (divergence theorem) of the converted STL vs scipy ConvexHull volume; occlusion ratio = hull/mesh; ratio 1.0 = convex solid, >1.05 flagged as an occluded pocket/aperture

S1_cutter_stacks.collision: per-solid (each cutter disc, spacer, shaft segment its own collider)
S1_cutter_stacks.inter_solid_channels: OPEN by construction — no hull spans multiple solids; disc pitch 6.4 mm with spacer-filled hubs, A/B interleave gap is between bodies (articulation self-collision off)
S1_cutter_stacks.in_solid_occlusion: hook pockets on cutter rims — handled by convexDecomposition

S2_rotor.collision: single solid RIGID_CYCLOID_HOOK_ROTOR_ENVELOPE — convex hull would fill the lobe windows and weld the rotor to an effective full cylinder
S2_rotor.fix: convexDecomposition approximation (PhysX cooked V-HACD) authored in full_machine.py
